subject.title: acp: assistant text corrupted when Gateway revises in-progress output (non-append revision mis-sliced)

question: How should the ACP bridge represent Gateway replace=true revisions when standard ACP message chunks cannot retract already-emitted text?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but the dependency contract means emitting the full replacement as another normal chunk can still leave stale text in append-only clients.

options.title: Choose conservative ACP mapping
options.body: Buffer or otherwise avoid unretractable provisional output when replacement semantics are possible, then add text and thinking regression tests.

options.title: Adopt a client-specific replace extension
options.body: Use ACP metadata or a known client capability only if maintainers accept non-standard behavior and document fallback semantics.

options.title: Accept corrected follow-up message
options.body: Emit replacements as a new visible message/messageId and accept that some clients may show both stale and corrected text.

recommendation.title: Choose conservative ACP mapping
recommendation.body: Buffer or otherwise avoid unretractable provisional output when replacement semantics are possible, then add text and thinking regression tests.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the ACP bridge and have the broadest current history across ACP translator behavior and protocol-facing choices.
